items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: there was a girl called Beulah. She was Buck's girlfriend and I was supposed to take her away from Buck in this play

ctx.x: studio, I did a love scene in that show. That was before I got to "Porgy and Bess." Understand, I did this film called "Black Narcissus," there was a girl called Beulah. She was Buck's girlfriend and I was supposed to take her away from Buck in this play, then being a singer it was easy for me to renew the love scene.
How did you feel about doing those types of scenes? Were you comfortable with them?
